title: Lake Crabtree County Park

services.name: Boat Rental
services.desc: Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays and Holidays ONLY (see schedule below) 10 a.m.-6 p.m. Rentals stop at 5 p.m. All rentals are FREE for 2 hours, and require a valid photo ID to rent. All rentals are on a first-come, first-served basis and cannot be reserved in advance. Life vests and paddles are provided. Customers must be at least 18 years of age, or 16 years of age accompanied by a parent or guardian on the water. As a reminder, visitors are always welcome to launch their own boats at locations indicated in the park. See the “Public Boat Launching” section below.
